cards.text: Last chapter of Numbers, friend. Earlier, a man from Manasseh named Zelophehad died with no sons, and the LORD settled who would get his land (Numbers 27:1-11). Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead, from Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, walk up to Moses, Israel's leader, and the heads of Israel's families to talk about that ruling.

cards.question: The family heads remind Moses what the LORD already commanded. Zelophehad's inheritance is to go to his ___.

cards.text: Then they lay out the problem, and it's a big "what if."

cards.question: If Zelophehad's daughters marry men from other tribes of Israel, what do the family heads say happens to their land?

answers.text: It is added to the tribe they marry into
It goes back to Moses to give out again
It is split up among the tribe of Levi

cards.text: Then they bring up the Jubilee, and even then, they say, the land would stay with the tribe the daughters marry into. Friend, these men aren't planning for next week, they're planning all the way out to the JUBILEE.
Moses doesn't wing this one. He answers at the word of the LORD, and trust me, every time I wing a batch, the smoke alarm has something to say.

cards.question: Moses answers the family heads from the clan of Gilead, part of the tribe of the sons of Joseph. What does he say about their concern?
Moses gives the LORD's command about Zelophehad's daughters. Who are the daughters allowed to marry?

answers.text: Anyone in a clan of their father's tribe
Only men Moses picks for them
Any man from any tribe of Israel

cards.text: Then Moses says no inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe. And he gives the reason.

cards.question: Why can't an inheritance in Israel move from one tribe to another?

answers.text: Each Israelite keeps his fathers' tribal land
The tribes would start fighting over borders
The lots can never be cast a second time

cards.question: Moses says the rule about marrying within a clan of her father's tribe is only for Zelophehad's daughters, not for any other daughter in Israel who inherits land.

cards.text: Moses says it one more time: each tribe of Israel must keep its inheritance. Now it's up to Zelophehad's daughters.

cards.question: Moses has passed along the LORD's command about who they can marry. What do Zelophehad's daughters do next?

answers.text: They obey and do as they were told
They ask Moses to change the ruling
They give the land to their uncles

cards.text: Here are the sisters, by name: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah (not the Noah who built the ark, Genesis 6:14).

cards.question: The daughters of Zelophehad were married to ___ on their father's side.
After the daughters marry within the clans of Manasseh, their inheritance stays within the tribe of their father's clan.

cards.text: And that's how Numbers wraps up: these are the commandments and ordinances the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho. The land stays with the family, friend, the same way this gold base stays with me.
